engine.win_condition: Generate energy counters by casting artifacts with Dr. Madison Li, then convert energy into card advantage, artifact recursion, and board buffs. Win through artifact-based combat damage or the Mechanized Production combo.

Mill cards via rad counters and dedicated mill effects, triggering The Wise Mothman to place +1/+1 counters on creatures based on cards milled. Proliferate and counter-doubling effects amplify growth, creating an overwhelming attacking force.

Generate tokens through Caesar's sacrifice trigger and token generators like Assemble the Legion, then drain opponents through aristocrats payoffs (Bastion of Remembrance, Pitiless Plunderer). Caesar's third mode deals direct damage based on token count as an alternate finisher.

Generate energy through casting artifacts and artificers, use Saheeli's ability to create hasty token copies of powerful permanents, and win through combat damage. Lightning Runner provides an infinite combat combo line when combined with energy generation.

Fill the graveyard through self-mill and sacrifice to achieve delirium, then use Winter's end-step ability to repeatedly reanimate high-impact permanents like Hornet Queen and Grist. Wins through overwhelming recursive value.

Trigger landfall repeatedly to manifest creatures face-down via Zimone, then flip high-value permanents. Generate overwhelming board presence through Scute Swarm tokens and landfall payoffs like Tatyova and Aesi, winning through combat damage.

Generate artifact tokens (Food and Clues) by casting historic spells through the commanders' abilities, leverage legendary and artifact synergies via Heroes' Podium and Day of Destiny, and win through accumulated card advantage and board presence.

Attack repeatedly to trigger The Tenth Doctor's exile-and-suspend ability while Rose Tyler grows larger with time counters from each attack. Win through combat damage with an increasingly massive Rose Tyler backed by value from suspended cards resolving.

Cast spells from graveyard and exile to trigger The Thirteenth Doctor's Paradox ability, accumulating +1/+1 counters on creatures and untapping them at end step for repeated value, then win through sustained combat damage.

Accumulate +1/+1 counters through Tidus's counter-moving and proliferate triggers from Inexorable Tide and Grateful Apparition, then win via Walking Ballista direct damage or overwhelming board presence. The Ballista + Hardened Scales combo provides an instant-win alternate line.
